Brownwater Town: A small coastal town, suburban housing style and beachfront properties. Surrounded by water and mountains, bridges or the train are the only ways out of town.
Town layout: Mountains to north west, west, south west and east of town, beach on south edge of town, estuary waters wrap around the west of town and along the north side.

Population:350,000.
Brownwater contains:[mall(north side of town, in the business district),train station(business district/north side, two concrete platforms), beach(south side of town),main road(runs parallel to beach), holiday inn(tourists, small cabins, tents, trailer park)]

key:Beach
content: A beach with life-savers, small waves, golden sands, sand dunes lined with bushes and chained wooden slats leading down to the beach. The park is near the beach
Clothing Style: Most people wear swimmers.

key: main road
content: A road that runs parallel to the beach, tourist trap.
Shops: post office, chemist, cafes, surf shop, bike shop, clothing stores, lots of tourists. 
Landmarks: East end of the road has open-air markets, West end loops up the mountain then down to a small fishing village on the other side.
Clothing Style: casual, bikini's, swimmers.

key:train station
content: A two platform train station. Both directions head towards larger cities.
Clothing Style:Formal,casual,school uniform, dressed up.

key: North bridge
content: A concrete bridge that spans over the estuary, leads towards a larger city, people often fish underneath the bridge. Oyster traps in the estuary, occasionally a boat putters by.

key: East Bridge
content: The east bridge is a concrete bridge around 40m above the estuary waters and kids often jump off into the water below as a dare.
Boats often pass underneath, many are sailing boats, some are fishing boats, occasionally a jetski buzzes through.
